method: Higgsfield server-side video_analysis of each 5s clip (free, ~16s/clip); judged vs intended motion + creative rules; cross-clip consistency panels. No human viewing / no render.
headline: Male lead is rendered BALD/SHAVED in cool-toned story clips while on-model in warm performance clips. Plus 4 content failures (C06,C07,C22,C23) and 1 woman drift (C16).

man_consistency.pattern: Warm wood-paneled PERFORMANCE clips render hair correctly; cool RAIN/WINDOW/MIRROR/LIGHTNING clips render him bald/shaved. The model generates two different men by lighting context.

woman_consistency.note: C07 has NO woman at all (reflection failed), so it is a content failure, not a woman-consistency issue. C04's reflection is correct brunette.
woman_consistency.recommendation: Lock a reference Element/Soul from C15's fogged mirror-face; regenerate only C16 from auburn to dark brunette (or increase steam occlusion).

root_cause_fix: Lock the lead with ONE character reference from a clean performance frame (C02/C12/C20) showing the short, receding-but-present red-blonde hairline; add negative guidance 'not bald, not shaved, not buzzed; visible hair on top with receding hairline' to every non-performance STILL (the start-frame still defines appearance); pin age 'late 30s'. Regenerate the STILL first, then re-animate (kling3_0), then re-run video_analysis to verify on-model before accepting.
edl_duration_note: EDL sums to 276.0s but this mix targets 274s (4:34); the assembler's audio cap currently hard-truncates the final C23 hold ~2s early. Trim ~2s upstream in the beat-lock pass so the ending lands on the music resolve (~4:33.8).
